mapper.sql: s.student_id, s.student_no, s.name, COALESCE(dc.college_name, s.college) AS college, COALESCE(se.college_id, s.college_id) AS college_id, COALESCE(se.major_id, s.major_id) AS major_id, COALESCE(se.class_id, s.class_id) AS class_id, COALESCE(se.grade_year, s.grade_year, dcl.grade_year) AS grade_year, dm.major_name AS major_name, dcl.class_name AS class_name, COALESCE(sp.learning_index, s.learning_index) AS learning_index, s.comparison_last_month, COALESCE(w.total_warnings, s.total_warnings, 0) AS total_warnings, COALESCE(w.resolved_warnings, s.resolved_warnings, 0) AS resolved_warnings, s.learning_scores, s.average_course_scores

FROM student s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT se1.student_id, se1.college_id, se1.major_id, se1.class_id, se1.grade_year FROM student_enrollment se1 JOIN ( SELECT student_id, MAX(enrollment_id) AS max_enrollment_id FROM student_enrollment WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY student_id ) latest ON latest.student_id = se1.student_id AND latest.max_enrollment_id = se1.enrollment_id ) se ON se.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN dim_college dc ON dc.college_id = COALESCE(se.college_id, s.college_id) LEFT JOIN dim_major dm ON dm.major_id = COALESCE(se.major_id, s.major_id) LEFT JOIN dim_class dcl ON dcl.class_id = COALESCE(se.class_id, s.class_id) LEFT JOIN student_portrait sp ON sp.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fwe.student_id, COUNT(*) AS total_warnings, SUM(CASE WHEN fwe.status = 'resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolved_warnings FROM fact_warning_event fwe GROUP BY fwe.student_id ) w ON w.student_id = s.student_id

where.if: AND ( s.college LIKE CONCAT('%', #{student.college}, '%') OR dc.college_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{student.college}, '%') )
